  content = '## A Monster Mash

Werewolf by Night was a delightful surprise — a black-and-white Disney+ special presentation directed by composer Michael Giacchino that paid homage to classic Universal monster movies. It introduced the supernatural horror corner of the MCU with genuine scares, practical effects, and a heartfelt story about a man and his monster friend.

## The Legacy

- **Horror MCU** — Proved the MCU could do genuine horror in a streaming format
- **Man-Thing** — Finally brought the beloved Marvel monster to live action
- **Black & White** — The first MCU project filmed entirely in black and white
- **Michael Giacchino** — The legendary composer made his directorial debut
- **Practical Effects** — Used practical monster effects over CGI for authenticity

## Fun Facts

- Michael Giacchino is best known as a film composer (Up, The Incredibles, Spider-Man: Homecoming)
- The special was filmed in black and white as a tribute to 1930s-40s Universal horror films
- Man-Thing was achieved primarily through practical puppet effects
- At only 52 minutes, it is one of the shortest MCU productions
- The Bloodstone connects to the wider MCU mythology and the Infinity Stones lore

## Viewing Context

Werewolf by Night is a **standalone Disney+ special** that requires no prior MCU knowledge. It introduces the monster-hunting corner of the Marvel universe. Jack Russell and Elsa Bloodstone are expected to appear in future MCU projects related to the supernatural side of Marvel.',
